{{Quote|Pirates. I wonder if it's anyone I know...|Mara Jade watching a freighter depart the spaceport|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
'''Katraasii Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katraasii]].<ref name="MOTS" />

During the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] era,<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening scrawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Katraasii Spaceport was known for its [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity and frequented by criminals like [[Abron Mar]]. The city featured at least three [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], including Mar's [[Unidentified Katraasii cantina|favorite]], market places, and multiple [[Hangar/Legends|ship docks]]. A burgeoning art scene developed on the world through [[Ugnaught/Legends|ugnaught]] theater and an exclusive [[Katraasii Droid Ballet Studio|droid ballet studio]]. 

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening scrawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] went there to look for Mar while seeking [[Takara]], but fell into a trap by [[Takara's organization|Takara's men]] with help from the local [[Dark Empire|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I love building big city levels, and I had lots of fun hiding "easter eggs" all over this one. At one point, Mara busts into a docking bay, and we see a familiar YT-1300 taking off. She says "Is that who I think it is?"|Ryan Kaufman on designing Katraasii Spaceport|<ref name="BTS Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>
}}
Katraasii Spaceport appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> Designer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] built both levels this location featured in the game.<ref name="BTS Blog" />
